description: Generated source-record identifier; not an independently verified patient identifier
source_variable: Source row in combined original files
coding: Positive integer
derivation: row_number() assigned before ARD selection; source-file and within-file record lookup exported separately

description: Original machine-learning partition retained as provenance
derivation: Assigned from the original input file; not re-randomised
reference_or_contrast: First level train_2015_17; not a term in the illustrative model

description: Calendar period of the source cohort
derivation: Assigned from input cohort; no exact patient dates are introduced
reference_or_contrast: Separate models are fitted by period

description: Presence of existing diabetic retinopathy
coding: 0 = absent; 1 = present
derivation: Trim and uppercase source text; N -> 0, Y -> 1, anything else -> NA and outcome validation fails
reference_or_contrast: 0 denotes absence; model response is integer 0/1

description: Labelled representation of the DR outcome
coding: No_DR; DR_Present
derivation: Factor derived from dr_status with levels 0 and 1
reference_or_contrast: No_DR is the first factor level

description: Age brackets supplied in the public release
derivation: Trim source text and preserve these ordered levels; unexpected values become NA and fail validation
reference_or_contrast: Ordered factor; R default polynomial contrasts, not one reference age group

description: Masked sex category; original category meanings are undisclosed
coding: Code_0; Code_1; NA for missing source
derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; no clinical or demographic relabelling

description: Masked ethnicity category; original category meanings are undisclosed
coding: Code_0; Code_1; NA for missing source
derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; no clinical or demographic relabelling

description: Duration of diabetes after project-specified screening
coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
derivation: Keep source value when 0 <= value <= 85; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.

description: HbA1c measurement after project-specified screening
coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
derivation: Keep source value when 3 <= value <= 25; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.

description: Operational HbA1c group; labels do not establish individual treatment targets
coding: Controlled_lt7; Suboptimal_7_to_8.9; Uncontrolled_ge9
derivation: <7%; >=7% and <9%; >=9%; NA when hba1c_clean is missing

description: Blood urea nitrogen measurement after project-specified screening
coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
derivation: Keep source value when 0 < value <= 250; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.
reference_or_contrast: Used to derive BUN threshold flag

description: Operational BUN threshold indicator; does not establish renal disease
coding: FALSE; TRUE; NA
derivation: TRUE for BUN >20 mg/dL, FALSE otherwise; NA for missing BUN

description: Systolic blood-pressure measurement after project-specified screening
coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
derivation: Keep source value when 50 <= value <= 300; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.
reference_or_contrast: Used to derive BP threshold flag

description: Diastolic blood-pressure measurement after project-specified screening
coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
derivation: Keep source value when 30 <= value <= 200; additionally value < cleaned SBP when SBP is observed; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.
reference_or_contrast: Used to derive BP threshold flag

description: Operational BP threshold indicator; does not establish a hypertension diagnosis
coding: FALSE; TRUE; NA
derivation: NA if either pressure is missing; otherwise TRUE when SBP >=140 or DBP >=90 mmHg

description: Haemoglobin measurement after project-specified screening
coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
derivation: Keep source value when 3 <= value <= 25; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.

description: Triglyceride measurement after project-specified screening
coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
derivation: Keep source value when 0 < value <= 5000; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.

description: Masked insulin-dependence category; original category meanings are undisclosed
coding: Code_1; Code_2; NA for missing source
derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; do not infer presence or absence from descriptive associations

description: Masked nephropathy category; original category meanings are undisclosed
coding: Code_1; Code_2; NA for missing source
derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; do not infer presence or absence from descriptive associations

description: Masked neuropathy category; original category meanings are undisclosed
coding: Code_1; Code_2; NA for missing source
derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; do not infer presence or absence from descriptive associations

description: Masked stroke category; original category meanings are undisclosed
coding: Code_1; Code_2; NA for missing source
derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; do not infer presence or absence from descriptive associations

description: HbA1c missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
derivation: is.na(hba1c_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

description: BUN missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
derivation: is.na(bun_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

description: One or both blood-pressure measurements missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
derivation: is.na(sbp_clean) OR is.na(dbp_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

description: Haemoglobin missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
derivation: is.na(hemoglobin_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

description: Triglycerides missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
derivation: is.na(triglycerides_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

description: Diabetes duration missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
derivation: is.na(duration_yrs_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

description: Number of missing grouped measurements after cleaning; not a count of individual laboratory tests
coding: Integer from 0 to 6
derivation: Sum six miss_* flags; BP contributes at most one, and diabetes duration is included
